00210.clinical_review: FOLFOX-4 uses separate day-1 and day-2 fluorouracil administrations. Confirm both appointments and both 22-hour infusions on the fortnightly calendar. Document adjuvant or metastatic intent.

00213.clinical_review: This 21-day single-agent irinotecan pathway follows an established fluorouracil-containing regimen in advanced colorectal cancer. Distinguish early cholinergic symptoms during infusion from delayed diarrhoea needing the written home action plan.

00216.clinical_review: For the standard intermittent schedule, record the first and last tablet doses and the seven-day break. Verify tablet strength and the prescribed dose against the indication, renal function and any prior dose reduction.

00421.clinical_review: The fluorouracil pump continues across weekends during the radiotherapy course. Arrange weekly pump exchanges and document radiation appointments separately. Escalate leaks, line swelling or chest pain promptly.

00586.clinical_review: The radiation-day capecitabine schedule is taken twice daily on days 1–5 of each seven-day cycle. Reconcile holidays or missed radiotherapy fractions with radiation oncology before giving new tablet instructions.
